div.head: Wi 15
div.ab: Gif þeow ete his sylfes ræde, VI scll' oþþe his hyd.
Gif þeow ete his sylfes ræde, VI scll' oþþe his hyd.
Gif þeow ete his sylfes ræde, VI scƚƚ oþþe his hyd.
wenn ein Sklav [es] isst aus seinem eigenen Entschluss, [büsse er dem Herrn] 6 Schll. oder seine Haut.
if a slave eats [it] of his own decision, [let him pay his lord] 6 shillings or his hide.
If a slave eats of his own free will, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation or undergo the lash.
If a slave eat it of his own accord [he is to pay] six shillings or be flogged.
If a slave eats of his own accord, 6 shillings or his hide.

note.seg: Ebenso späteres Recht; s. Gl Fasten 5a. 8b; Prügel 4d. Der Herr empfängt das Strafgeld laut o. 10
So too later law; see Gl Fasten 5a. 8b; Prügel 4d. The lord receives the fine, as above 10
